verdict.rationale: GitLab's technology-partner directory lists a Zulip integration that delivers GitLab project notifications into chat and a Slack integration for working with GitLab from a Slack workspace. Make is also listed as a way to send GitLab-triggered notifications. These cover the core of syncing repository activity to chat tools, but only as one-line directory blurbs. Missing for 10: first-party configuration docs detailing which events/activity types sync to Slack or other chat tools, Microsoft Teams/Discord coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
